{{Quote|The Kelrodoans may not have sophisticated technology. They may have primitive customs. But they deserve to contribute to the Empire while enjoying its security&mdash;and that's what we're bringing them.|[[Shea Hublin]]|<ref name="The Guns of Kelrodo-Ai" />}}
The '''Kelrodoans''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kelrodo-Ai/Legends|Kelrodo-Ai]]. During the [[Western Reaches Operation]] in [[17 ABY/Legends|17 BBY]], the forces of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Battle of Kelrodo-Ai|attacked]] Kelrodo-Ai and several Kelrodoans, including the warrior chieftain [[Fara (Kelrodoan)|Fara]], were assigned to act as grooms for the [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] of the Empire's [[Sword Squadron (Imperial)|Sword Squadron]].
